psum spargente εν παντὶ τόπῳ in omni loco, 2 Cor. II. 14.
Certum quoque exploratumque est maturè satis Romæ
Evangelium prædicatum, plurresque ad illud conversos esse.
Omitto equidem definire, an, quod Claudius jussit Ju-
dæos Roma facessere, Act. XVIII. 2. tumultuantes impulso-

page.notes: The marginal notes are set in small italic type in the right margin, beside the lines of the second paragraph; the note's text is split across lines and has been joined. The word "tuanus" at the head is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The printed note reads "Circa eam certa ac explorata ab incertis, dubiis, suspectis & falsis distinguuntur." Greek words are transcribed as read and may differ slightly from the printed accents.
